delivery_graph_description: Sends through Microsoft Graph from the company mailbox. No sign-in or MFA is needed when sending.
delivery_smtp_description: Sends through the mail server configured on the hosting account (cPanel).
delivery_error_save: Unable to save. Please try again.
delivery_description: Choose how AppraisalSuite sends email. Changes apply immediately to every email, need a reason and are recorded in the Audit Log.
delivery_migration_notice: Apply migration 19 to enable switching. Until then, emails use {{provider}} from the server settings.
delivery_expired_secret: The Microsoft 365 client secret expired on {{date}}. Microsoft 365 cannot send until a new secret is added to .env (GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET and GRAPH_SECRET_EXPIRES).
delivery_secret_soon_one: The Microsoft 365 client secret expires in {{count}} day ({{date}}). Create a new secret in Entra and update GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET and GRAPH_SECRET_EXPIRES in .env before then.
delivery_secret_soon_other: The Microsoft 365 client secret expires in {{count}} days ({{date}}). Create a new secret in Entra and update GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET and GRAPH_SECRET_EXPIRES in .env before then.
delivery_methods_description: Send a test email before switching, to confirm the method works.
delivery_not_configured: Not set up on the server
delivery_missing_settings: Add these settings to the server’s .env file: {{settings}}.
delivery_rate: Large sends are paced to {{count}} emails a minute.
delivery_test_note: Any mailbox, including outside ones such as Gmail, to check where it lands. Up to 10 tests an hour.
delivery_backup_note: Recommended, so notifications are not lost if one method has a problem.
delivery_retry_description: The same email is tried once more through the other method. Both attempts appear in the status above.
delivery_backup_unavailable: {{provider}} is not set up, so the backup cannot run
delivery_changes_audit: Also recorded in the Audit Log.
delivery_no_changes: No changes yet. Emails have always used {{provider}}.
delivery_footer: Only the Super Admin can change these settings. Passwords and client secrets stay in the server’s .env file and are never shown here.

delivery_dialog_test_succeeded: The test email for this method succeeded.
delivery_dialog_test_first: Consider sending a test email first.
delivery_dialog_backup_on: If {{active}} fails, the email will be retried through {{backup}}.
delivery_dialog_backup_off: If {{active}} fails, the email will not be retried and the failure will be reported.
delivery_reason_provider_graph: For example: switching to {{provider}} for better delivery
delivery_reason_provider_smtp: For example: switching to {{provider}} while Microsoft 365 is being fixed
